comment: Place at public/firmware/manifest.json. The key for each model MUST match the hw string the device reports in its BLE hello packet. Model V (Build B / Everything-in-C, Rev C board) reports hw:"V"; it reported hw:"III.I" before fw 1.3.3-c, which matched no key here and silently disabled OTA for that device. 'version' is compared against the device's reported fw with semantic ordering (parseInt per component, so a "-c" suffix is ignored); 'file' is the path (relative to the web root) of the raw .bin image. Bump 'version' and replace the .bin to ship an update.

IV.notes: native-C · identity LED + OTA auth gate + version-report fix. Served .bin unchanged from 1.4.2 test — 1.4.3 is a trigger bump to test the pipelined fast-OTA transfer (app-side change only).

V.notes: native-C · Rev C board · NDJSON notify framing (1.3.2-c) + hw reported as "V" (1.3.3-c). ADXL372 fitted but not yet read by firmware.
